distance (mi/day)","hideWhenNoData":true},"glossary_md":{"type":"splunk.markdown","options":{"backgroundColor":"rgba(15,17,23,0.50)","markdown":"### About these metrics
- **Walking speed** — your average steady walking pace. **↑ higher is better** — a stable or rising speed is a good mobility sign; a sustained drop can flag fatigue, injury, or aging.
- **Step length** — distance covered per step. **↑ higher is better** — shorter steps often go with slower, more cautious walking.
- **Double support %** — the share of each stride where *both* feet are on the ground at once. **↓ lower is better** — higher means more time stabilizing = less steady walking (rises with caution, fatigue, or balance issues).
- **Walking asymmetry %** — how unevenly your left and right steps are timed. **↓ lower is better** — 0% is perfectly even; higher means one side differs from the other (can point to injury or imbalance).
- **Gait quality** — double-support + asymmetry read together: *how steady and even* your walking is. **↓ lower is better** for both.
- **Audio exposure** — **Environmental** (surroundings, via mic) and **Headphone** (playback level) sound, in dBASPL. **↓ lower is better** — sustained exposure above ~80 dB is where hearing risk climbs.
- **Physical effort** — Apple's estimate of exertion intensity (kcal/hr·kg, a METs-style intensity). **Context-dependent** — higher during workouts is expected, not inherently good or bad.
- **Time in daylight** — minutes per day in outdoor light (ambient light + GPS). **↑ higher is generally better** — tied to circadian rhythm, sleep, and mood.
- **Breathing disturbances** — nightly count of possible breathing interruptions during sleep (Apple's sleep-apnea-adjacent signal). **↓ lower is better** — the trend matters more than any single night.
- **Cycling distance** — miles ridden per day from Apple Watch cycling workouts. **Neutral** — activity volume, goal-dependent.

_These are Apple-only signals (`apple:extra`), shown in the units Apple/HAE exported (US locale here)._

**Learn more:** [Apple — Health](https://www.apple.com/health/)"}}},"layout":{"type":"absolute","options":{"width":1440,"height":2040,"display":"auto"},"structure":[{"item":"intro_md","type":"block","position":{"x":20,"y":20,"w":1400,"h":130}},{"item":"walkspeed_sv","type":"block","position":{"x":20,"y":170,"w":340,"h":150}},{"item":"steplen_sv","type":"block","position":{"x":370,"y":170,"w":340,"h":150}},{"item":"dblsupport_sv","type":"block","position":{"x":720,"y":170,"w":340,"h":150}},{"item":"asymmetry_sv","type":"block","position":{"x":1070,"y":170,"w":350,"h":150}},{"item":"walkspeed_trend","type":"block","position":{"x":20,"y":340,"w":690,"h":300}},{"item":"gait_trend","type":"block","position":{"x":730,"y":340,"w":690,"h":300}},{"item":"hearing_trend","type":"block","position":{"x":20,"y":660,"w":690,"h":300}},{"item":"effort_trend","type":"block","position":{"x":730,"y":660,"w":690,"h":300}},{"item":"daylight_col","type":"block","position":{"x":20,"y":980,"w":690,"h":300}},{"item":"breathing_col","type":"block","position":{"x":730,"y":980,"w":690,"h":300}},{"item":"cycling_col","type":"block","position":{"x":20,"y":1300,"w":1400,"h":280}},{"item":"glossary_md","type":"block","position":{"x":20,"y":1600,"w":1400,"h":400}}],"globalInputs":["input_global_trp","input_person"]}}
